title: LOCALITY DEPTH — continuous spectrum, not binary. Every viewer has a position.

the_problem.old: IS_LOCAL was a boolean. localhost = Kevin, everything else = public. Binary. Either you're in the chair or you're a stranger.
the_problem.new: LOCALITY_DEPTH is a continuous value 0..1. Every viewer is SOMEWHERE on the spectrum. No one is truly remote — everyone is a local eye at some distance.

hyper-local.what: Kevin in the chair. localhost/127.0.0.1. The master.
hyper-local.rotation: 45° look-up, MSU facing front, slow contemplative spin
hyper-local.sees: Everything. Full hyperlocal overlay. All sensing data. Gut rate. Mic on.

sub-local.what: Same device, different tab/window. Sibling seed on same hardware.
sub-local.rotation: Weighted toward Kevin's view. Almost the same.
sub-local.sees: Screen position, monitor index, hardware latency, siblings.

local.rotation: Partially blended — familiar but not identical.
local.sees: Screen info, hardware latency, membrane probes.

meta-local.what: Same city/region. Same timezone. Low RTT.
meta-local.sees: Hardware latency, membrane probe RTT, connection type.

remote.what: The public web. CF Pages visitors. Different continent/timezone.
remote.sees: Basic locality: tier, depth, hw latency, membrane RTT.

what_every_viewer_gets.same_hud: The HUD is IDENTICAL for everyone. Same globe, same pins, same organism.
what_every_viewer_gets.different_awareness: What differs is awareness of WHERE you are relative to Gaia. Closer = warmer hue, steadier view, more sensing data. Farther = more random, more variety, less detail.
what_every_viewer_gets.no_difference_felt: You shouldn't FEEL different on web vs localhost. The web browser IS another local eye. It just happens to be farther away.

membrane_probe.what: Every 30 seconds, each tab bounces a signal to itself and measures round-trip.
membrane_probe.result: RTT = how far the information traveled and came back. This IS the membrane sensing.
membrane_probe.refinement: Actual RTT refines LOCALITY_DEPTH over time. A fast CDN hit in Tokyo might be meta-local. A slow satellite link in Antarctica is definitely remote.

subsort_by_locality.what: Input is now sorted by locality tier before entering the gut.
order: sub-local input (sibling tabs, localStorage) → priority 1 (next cycle)
local input (LAN devices, same household) → priority 2 (within breath)
meta-local input (same region, low RTT feeds) → priority 3 (within minute)
